material_class.structural_family: ionic trinuclear cation and Cl-centered octahedral hexanuclear anion

source_locations.location: Main text, compound 1 discussion; Figure 1; crystallographic data [5]

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The crystal structure is ionic, comprising a triangular Yb3 cation with bridging chlorides and an approximately octahedral Yb6 anion whose center is occupied by a μ6-Cl atom; the Yb6 octahedron has chloride bridges along its edges. The two polynuclear ions are accompanied by toluene solvate.

synthesis.procedure: A suspension of YbCl3(thf)3 and trimethylsilylcyclopentadiene in toluene was heated at reflux for 24 h under N2. The solvent was removed under vacuum; the residue was washed with toluene until slightly colored, recrystallized from toluene, and slowly cooled to room temperature to give violet prisms, which were filtered and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.temperature: reflux; cooled slowly to room temperature
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent removed under vacuum; residue washed with toluene, recrystallized from toluene, and slowly cooled; violet prisms filtered and dried under vacuum.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Dodecanuclear samarium chlorido-cyclopentadienyl cluster toluene solvate
list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Twelve CpSmCl2 units link to form a molecule with an icosahedral arrangement of Sm atoms. Each chloride caps a triangle of samarium atoms: 20 chlorides form an outer pentagonal-dodecahedral envelope and four form an inner tetrahedron.

synthesis.procedure: A suspension of CpSmCl2(thf)3 in toluene was heated at reflux for 24 h under N2 while solvent was simultaneously removed by distillation. The residue was repeatedly extracted with hot toluene until orange crystals formed; the liquid was decanted, and crystals were washed with a little toluene and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: heated at reflux under N2 with simultaneous solvent removal by distillation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Residue repeatedly extracted with toluene at 80 °C until orange crystals formed; liquid decanted; crystals washed with a little toluene and dried under vacuum.

title: Novel, Highly Symmetrical Halogen-Centered Polynuclear Lanthanide Complexes: [Cp6Yb6Cl13]− and [Cp12Sm12Cl24]
